fields.reasoning: Intent: m24-on-the-vm is the landed intent the previous Fix (folder trust, 01M6FSQ) serves, and this failure also hits the VM's unattended daemon. Approach: the main checkout must keep drafts' and accepted change sets' first entries, since the daemon reads in-flight change sets there, so writing them only in a worktree would hide them; dropping only files identical to incoming main loses nothing (main has the same bytes) and also fixes ship-change close-outs. Retry: internal/api/ship_close.go removes t.statePath() under r.Forget before shipMainBlocked and git pull --ff-only, so a failed pull leaves no state for a retry; moving the removal after step update-main makes close-out idempotent. All three follow the question's recommendations, which the code and the change set's intent support.
fields.statement: Change set 01M6GCP serves m24-on-the-vm. Before pulling main, close-out removes untracked .rhiza/log files in the main checkout that the incoming main has byte for byte, then pulls; untracked files that differ or are absent from main stay, and the pull reports them as it does now. `ship close-out --forget` deletes the ship state only after main is updated, so a close-out whose pull failed can be retried and finishes.
